rule: Every library item version a consumer pins or proposes is adopted (lineage.mode verbatim) or customized (lineage.mode customized) from a trusted reference, recorded as lineage.source with registry, item, version and hash. The trusted registries are the registries of references/manifest.json; the item, version and hash must match a manifest item. lineage.mode original is allowed only in a consumer-asset slot.

consumerAssets.why: Brand marks and media the consumer owns; no registry ships them.

classes.why: A font comes from its font provider (a shadcn registry:font item or the Fontsource package of the Google Fonts family), with family and version recorded.
A theme is a shadcn theme preset (or a trusted theme registry item) customized with the consumer's brand tokens.

need: When no trusted reference fits the slot contract, Designer raises a NEED for the owner (skill/library-needs.md) and leaves the slot unfilled; it never creates an original item outside a consumer-asset slot.
